PM Kisan.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
PM Kisan.description: Income support of Rs. 6000 per year in three equal installments to all landholding farmer families.

PM Jan Dhan Yojana.name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
PM Jan Dhan Yojana.description: National Mission for Financial Inclusion to ensure access to financial services like basic savings accounts, remittance, credit, insurance, and pension in an affordable manner.
documents: Aadhaar Card (or Voter ID, PAN card, Driving License, NREGA Job Card)

PM Shram Yogi Maandhan.name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan
PM Shram Yogi Maandhan.description: Voluntary and contributory pension scheme for unorganized workers to get Rs. 3000 monthly pension after age 60.
documents: Savings Bank Account / Jan Dhan Account details with IFSC

PM Suraksha Bima Yojana.name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
PM Suraksha Bima Yojana.description: Accident insurance scheme offering accidental death and disability cover of Rs. 2 Lakh for a premium of Rs. 20 per annum.
